saw_lines: Electric bike buyers want to ride before they commit, and a leasing number alone rarely closes a sale.
So the sale is won on a test ride or a trust signal, but your ads ask for the lease first.
Your 7 live ads carry no proof number, yet your site already answers where to demo a bike, so open the next three ads with a test ride.
ads_1: Test ride and V17 creatives that replace the leasing line as the opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, the only linked channel
